data.description: 【飞鸟马时 · 泳池潜伏任务】夏日湛蓝的度假泳池边，时身穿蓝白配色的特工分体泳装，腰间依然严谨地系着战术小包，手里端着一杯椰汁。她面无表情地戴着遮阳镜——「泳池区域警戒无异常……主人，时已经做好了随时为您下水排查危险的准备，Peace ✌️。」
data.promptProse: Toki stands at the resort pool in her white-and-blue swimsuit with a small tactical waist belt and headset, holding coconut juice while checking the area behind her sunglasses. The eye-level medium view aligns her with the pool edge and receding deck. Summer sun highlights the cup and belt fittings, and reflected water light ripples across the lower edge of her pale swimwear beneath the cooler shaded glasses.
